findings.description: The regression check compares the signed delta against max_drop directly (delta < max_drop), so it fails whenever delta is below a positive threshold, including any improvement or any drop smaller than max_drop.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a new run has hit@5_delta = +0.01 (improvement) or -0.02 (small drop), and the user runs with --compare and --max-drop 0.03. Mechanism: 0.01 < 0.03 and -0.02 < 0.03 are both true, so regression() returns a message and main raises SystemExit. The intended condition is delta < -max_drop. Impact: the CI gate exits non-zero on runs that did not regress, blocking merges, and the message reports a negative 'drop' for improvements.
